The client accepts the following QTE file name variants:
- qte_start.wav / qte-start.wav / qte_start.mp3 / qte-start.mp3
- qte_success.wav / qte-success.wav / qte_success.mp3 / qte-success.mp3
- qte_fail.wav / qte-fail.wav / qte_fail.mp3 / qte-fail.mp3

If a dedicated QTE file is absent, the client falls back to the existing minimal sound set.
